project: Western Harbour Tunnel and Warringah Freeway Upgrade SSI-8863

sources.title: Western Harbour Tunnel & Warringah Freeway Upgrade SSI-8863 MOD 3 Consolidated Approval
sources.finding: E219 requires a quantitative assessment of model predictive uncertainty at locations of primary importance, statistical calibration evaluation, independent expert peer review and consultation with DPE Water. It does not prescribe a numerical acceptable groundwater-head/drawdown prediction error that can serve as H_app, and it does not allocate any fraction of such an error requirement to numerical temporal/coupling error. Searches of the approval instrument for 'time step', 'time-step', 'temporal' and 'numerical error' returned no temporal-error allocation rule.

sources.authority: Western Harbour Tunnel project public construction portal / published project report
sources.title: GT02 Project Wide Hydrogeological Interpretive Report, WHTP2-AAJV-NWW-GE-GT02-RPT-000001 Rev C, 24 June 2024
sources.finding: The published report contains dedicated sections for predictions, sensitivity analysis, model uncertainty and limitations, uncertainty analysis and confidence-level classification. Such model-generated uncertainty characterization is evidence about prediction uncertainty, not by itself an externally governed acceptance requirement. No project/regulator statement was identified that converts an uncertainty percentile, calibration statistic or confidence classification into an admissible H_app or a temporal/coupling allocation.

sources.authority: Western Harbour Tunnel independent audit publications
sources.title: Independent audit evidence for SSI-8863 condition E219
sources.finding: The audit trail confirms the project-wide HIR, independent peer review and regulator consultation/submission process. This strengthens project provenance but does not introduce a numerical application prediction-accuracy acceptance limit or a temporal numerical-error allocation.

rejected_substitutions: 1 L/s/km tunnel inflow compliance criterion as groundwater-head prediction accuracy
drawdown, settlement or receptor impact thresholds as prediction error tolerance
calibration residual or RMSE as prospective prediction-accuracy requirement
model ensemble spread, percentile or confidence class as H_app without an external acceptance rule
monitoring trigger or observed model-data difference as H_app without a governed project decision rule
groundwater model time-step schedule as A_temporal
F-GC07 empirical coupling error or estimator magnitude as A_temporal
arbitrary percentage split of total application accuracy to coupling temporal error
required_to_reopen_positive_instantiatio: a versioned project or regulator-approved numerical groundwater-head/drawdown prediction-accuracy requirement with receptor/location/time-horizon and uncertainty semantics
an independently governed numerical temporal/coupling allocation or direct temporal head-error budget tied to that application requirement
nonclaims: the project does not lack useful groundwater uncertainty analysis
the project groundwater model is not declared scientifically inadequate
no statement is made that the project HIR uncertainty analysis is wrong
